interpretation.coverage: The H1 composite remains exceptional under the original strict n>=10 occurrence gate; the positive result is therefore not an artefact of lowering occurrence coverage to n>=5.
interpretation.region: The same fixed-vector H1 is directionally positive but not exceptional in the Japan-only n>=5 panel. The current support is therefore East-Asian/regional-context dependent rather than a Japan-only repeated rule.
interpretation.axis: At strict n>=10, neither BIO15 nor lower BIO1 alone crosses the frozen 0.05 rank threshold, whereas the predeclared composite does. The robust object is the joint two-axis regime, not either single climate variable.

claim_ceiling: Do not call this an East-Asian climate cause; it is present-niche transition-regime concordance.
Do not isolate BIO15 or BIO1 as the driver from this result.
Do not claim selection, adaptation, or transition-time environment.
